acts.desc: Ira relays advice from a staffer’s family on what to do if you’re thinking about something you don’t want to think about.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc:
Lulu Wang tells the story of an elaborate attempt to keep someone ignorant — her grandmother — and how her family pulled it off.
Lulu Wang's movie The Farewell is based on this story.
acts.title: What You Don't Know

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Sean Cole tells the story of a psychological experiment that proved ignorance is, in fact, bliss.
acts.title: Ignorance for Dummies

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Stephanie Foo describes a subset of the population who will never enjoy the benefits of ignorance — because they’re destined never to experience it in the first place.

songs.t: How Come U Don’t Call Me Anymore

acts.title: Forget Me? Not!
